title: Add subject deletion with chapter archiving, enhance AI suggester, add test analytics, study session summaries, emojis, Spider-Man theme, and countdown timer

requirements.text: Add option to delete a subject while preserving its chapters in an archive/unassigned section where they remain viewable but unlinked to any subject

quotes: ADD OPTION TO: 1) DELETE SUBJECT AND KEEP THE CHAPTER SAVE DON'T ASK TOPICS IN THAT
1 - (b) move those chapters to some kind of archive or 'unassigned chapters' section where you can still view them

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores deleted subject's chapters in an archived/unassigned state
Archived chapters remain accessible for viewing
Deletion UI includes confirmation prompt
Archived chapters section displays all unlinked chapters

requirements.text: Enhance AI suggester to prioritize subjects based on timeline proximity and test scores in addition to existing logic (low completion progress and topics due for revision)

quotes: 2) MAKE THE AI BASIS FOR SELECTING SUBJECT ON BASIS OF TIMELINE, MARKS SCORED IN TEST
2 - (b) combine these new factors with the existing logic (low completion progress and topics due for revision)

acceptanceCriteria: AI suggester considers subject target completion dates and time remaining
AI suggester factors in test scores when prioritizing subjects
Existing logic (low completion progress, revision due dates) remains active
Suggestions display reasoning that includes timeline and test score factors

requirements.text: Add progress bars for each subject in the test tracking interface showing test performance

quotes: 3) IN TEST ADD A PROGRESS BAR FOR EACH SUBJECT

acceptanceCriteria: Test tracking interface displays a progress bar per subject
Progress bar reflects aggregate test performance for that subject
Visual indicator shows percentage or completion status

requirements.text: Add analytical graphs to the test tracking interface visualizing test performance trends and statistics

quotes: 3) IN TEST ADD A PROGRESS BAR FOR EACH SUBJECT AND AN ANALYTICAL GRAPH

acceptanceCriteria: Analytical graphs display test scores over time
Graphs show subject-wise performance comparisons
Visualizations are clear and accessible

requirements.text: Add a study session summary section where users manually write summaries and important topics, then AI formats the text properly for final revision reference

quotes: 4) AFTER EVERY STUDY SESSION ADD A SECTION FOR WRITING SUMMARY AND IMPORTANT TOPICS WHICH SUMMARY IS CREATED BASED ON THE TOPICS FOR FINAL REVISION ON EXAM
3 - (b) a text field where you manually write your own summary and notes and formatted in proper manner with ai

acceptanceCriteria: Study session logging includes a text field for summary and important topics
User can manually enter their notes after each session
AI formats the entered text into a clean, structured format
Formatted summaries are stored and retrievable for final revision

requirements.text: Add cute emojis to each topic throughout the application for visual appeal and engagement

quotes: 5) ADD CUTE EMOJIES TO EACH TOPIC

acceptanceCriteria: Each topic displays a relevant cute emoji
Emojis are contextually appropriate
Emojis enhance visual appeal without cluttering UI

requirements.text: Apply a Spider-Man + CA themed design throughout the website combining Spider-Man's iconic red and blue color scheme with web patterns while maintaining professional academic focus appropriate for CA study tracking

quotes: 6) KEEP THE THEME OF WEBSITE AS MIXTURE OF SPIDERMAN AND CA
I'll blend the iconic Spider-Man aesthetic (red and blue color scheme, web patterns, dynamic energy) with professional CA elements (charts, analytics, academic focus)

acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme uses Spider-Man red and blue prominently
Web patterns incorporated into design elements
Professional academic tone maintained for study tracking
Theme is consistent across all pages and components

requirements.text: Add a countdown timer in the top right tab displaying the number of days remaining until May 1, 2028 (the final exam date)

quotes: 7) ADD A TIMELINE FOR FINAL PAPER - ON TOP RIGHT TAB IT SHOULS BE SHOWN THE COUNTDOWN IN NUMBER OF DAYS TO 1ST MAY 2028

acceptanceCriteria: Countdown timer appears in top right of the header/tab area
Timer calculates and displays days remaining until May 1, 2028
Display is prominent and always visible
Timer updates correctly as dates progress

requirements.text: Reorganize the Study tab to show all subjects with revision tracking in the same view, displaying individual progress for each subject

quotes: 8) SHOW SUBJECTS IN STUDY TAB IN THAT KEEP FOR ALL SUBJECTS AND THEN REVISION IN SAME TAB AND SHOW PROGRESS OF EACH SUBJECT

acceptanceCriteria: Study tab displays all subjects in one unified view
Revision tracking information shown within the same tab
Each subject shows its individual progress indicator
Layout is clear and organized for easy scanning

requirements.text: Add Spider-Man logo to the main page as a prominent branding element of the themed design

quotes: yeah and keep spiderman logo on main page

acceptanceCriteria: Spider-Man logo appears on the main/dashboard page
Logo placement is prominent and visually integrated
Logo complements the Spider-Man + CA theme

constraints: Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Use only React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, and React Query for frontend
Preserve existing data models and ensure backward compatibility
nonGoals: Implementing external AI service integrations for text formatting
Supporting multiple user accounts or multi-tenancy

required: Spider-Man logo illustration with transparent background suitable for header placement (spiderman-logo.dim_200x200.png)
